# rd_nodiscard_ab, rd_nodiscard_ab_gl and rd_nodiscard_clean (test/rd_nodiscard_ab.cmake):
# a fixture, then the profiles it is replayed under (corpus, mali, mali169,
# own: the script's head says what each is; OpenGL replays every fixture at
# the corpus setting without dual-source blending).  The Mali profiles must
# draw some pass through a twin over the whole list: on lavapipe only clip
# mode none (code 34) takes one, and only where the alpha plan leaves no test
# in the pass, which a fixture's blank-rule textures (alpha 00..ff) almost
# never allow (2026-11-22: fx-mali-slow541's passes were all refused for the
# alpha test); clean_min=N: rd_nodiscard_clean's floor of camera rule draws
# through a twin under each of the fixture's profiles without dual-source
# blending, the verdict taken as clean, of the forms the clipper check
# draws (rd_nd_checked_form: prelit 32 and 36): about a third of what the
# run with every twin pipeline made printed (75 and 641, the REV2ND merge
# check, before the form gate) times the share of those draws that are
# prelit (step 0 on the fixtures: 98 of 127 and 109 of 138); slow541 and
# drops-4657 have no floor until a run with the gate prints theirs (their
# camera rule draws may all be lit or skinned: the boat is lit code 32);
# these fixtures hold no eye-crossing triangle whose pixels differ under
# Mesa 25.0.7 (measured), so a verdict taken as clean is byte for byte on
# them there (another rasteriser may differ: the test then says which);
# the vu_opaque.rules.txt fixtures below have opaque textures,
# so their code 34 draws' tests are decided by the alpha plan.  The Mali
# profiles need a frame at least 16:9 wide (a 4:3 dump cannot show 16:9).
#
# issue 179's Mali-G52 (v0.11.5): the stage 42 slow-scene capture, 912 wide
fx-mali-slow541 mali,mali169,corpus
# issue 179's Mali-G52 (v0.11.7) loss capture, 912 wide, opaque textures:
# 181 code 34 draws (step 0's alpha-plan mirror finds every one eligible)
fx-mali-loss-before mali,mali169,corpus clean_min=19
# issue 179's Mali-G52 (v0.11.4) loss capture, 912 wide, opaque textures:
# 70 code 34 draws (all eligible by the same mirror)
fx-scope-179-before mali,mali169,corpus clean_min=170
